item.title: SMU, Methodist Conference End Legal Fight
item.description: A yearslong legal fight between SMU and the South Central Jurisdiction of the United Methodist Church is officially over.

item.title: UP Council Considers Post-DART Paratransit Services
item.description: University Park city leaders plan to keep paratransit services rolling if residents vote in May to withdraw from Dallas Area Rapid Transit (DART).

item.title: HP Town Council Reviews 2025 Crime Stats
item.description: Crime trends in the Town of Highland Park were mixed in 2025, council members heard on March 17 during a review of the Department of Public Safety 2025 Annual Report by Chief Chuck McGinnis.

item.title: At Least One Last Song for Poor David’s Pub
item.description: Highland Park musician Brice Beaird played what was to be his final gig at Poor David’s Pub with a tinge of sentimental nostalgia and a nod of thanks.

item.title: Creation Studio Helps Special Artists Share Ideas, Sell Their Work
item.description: I had the good fortune to visit and interview Creation Studio founder, director, and Preston Hollow native Hunter Lacey on opening day in January 2025.

item.title: We’ve Got Problems. These High Schoolers Have Ideas That Could Help
item.description: Private speech therapy can cost $100 an hour or more, and a critical scarcity of speech-language pathologists means that it can be difficult for some families to access care at all.
